frequency_question: How often do banking regulators successfully implement non-zero countercyclical capital buffers when structural friction and industry opposition are present?
membership_rule: Includes all instances where a G-10 central bank with an operational CCyB framework considered or implemented a non-zero buffer rate since the introduction of Basel III standards (2011-2026).

cases.name: Reserve Bank of New Zealand CCyB increase
Swiss National Bank countercyclical buffer activation

provenance_note: 5 cases named, 12 claimed via skeleton x multiplier (2.4x)
coverage_note: 4 named positive implementations among major G-12 banking jurisdictions; 8 maintained at zero despite institutional capability.
known_gaps: Excludes minor emerging market jurisdictions with less institutional friction similarity to the US.
skeleton: Total jurisdictions with active CCyB frameworks implementing >0% rates divided by total major jurisdictions with the framework established.
multiplier: 4 active implementers out of roughly 12 major jurisdictions over the post-Basel III implementation window.
validity_reason: Basel III macroprudential architecture standards remain stable and unchanged through this period.
